source_refs.note: Topic 5.5.1.1 Bar Charts (PDF 146, printed 143). Figure 5.4 has no category labels; the original diagram uses the chapter's Class A and Class B scores instead.

blocks.text: Bar charts compare categories: each bar is a category and its height or length shows the value. A store can compare sales of different products, or of the same products on two days, with grouped bars.
